experiment: Production-FFI-classifier deployment numbers (Edge tier). Consolidates latency, throughput, and FPR measured against / agreed for the REAL production TFLite FFI classifier (models/classifier_float32.tflite, d=42), not the surrogate.

basis_notes.latency: x86 dev values are from the fresh real-TFLite phase_latency run (#6 pipeline driven with EDGE_MODEL_PATH, real classifier). The prior #6 '0.1029 ms' figure used MockModel + artificial sleep and is superseded. Pi aarch64 real-model phase-split confirmation is PENDING (Pi link down at measurement time).
basis_notes.throughput: #5 already ran the REAL TFLite classifier on the Pi at maximum offered load; those aarch64 numbers are authoritative for throughput/SLA.
basis_notes.fpr: The Logarithmic-phase trigger is an epsilon_p > gamma GEOMETRY rule (features-only), so it is classifier-independent: the real-classifier FPR equals the surrogate measured value by construction.
basis_notes.memory: 1,680 B feature footprint (W x 4 x d = 10 x 4 x 42); earlier 1,200 B row assumed d=30.

archimedean.label: benign phase window, full 3-thread pipeline, real TFLite FFI classifier

sla_load_test_pi_compute_path.label: on-device Pi 5, compute path only (defense->rotation->TFLite), real classifier

latency_ms.conclusion: Every real-classifier latency figure (p50 ~0.002 ms, p99 ~0.01 ms) is orders of magnitude under the 50 ms Edge SLA; the SLA is non-binding.

throughput_pi.notes: 50,000 sustained adversarial (Logarithmic) queries at back-to-back max offered rate on Pi 5; 99.998% in adversarial phase; 0 SLA violations.

fpr.note: Gamma = benign epsilon_p P95 per paper rule; FPR 5.01% at operating gamma. Classifier-independent geometry trigger.
